sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Merchandising of Fashion Jewelry and Fine Timepieces

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Republic of the Marshall Islands (Unitary National Jurisdiction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (US-derived common-law principles; the Business Corporations Act 1990 is modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law; statutory law enacted by the Nitijela; customary law recognized in land and title matters)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States of America (1986, as amended 2003)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus, signed 2017; applicable to RMI)
US FATCA Model 1 Intergovernmental Agreement (2014) — tax information exchange instrument, not investment protection
No comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) network and no standalone bilateral investment treaties other than the US Compact

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act 2012 (as amended); Beneficial Ownership Information Regulations issued by the Financial Intelligence Unit; Business Corporations Act 1990, 51 MIRC Ch. 1 (as amended); Registered Agents Licensing Act 1991 (as amended); Economic Substance Regulations (as amended, effective for accounting periods beginning on or after 1 January 2020)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the biometric passport page of each ultimate beneficial owner, proposed director, and proposed officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport issuing authority in each individual's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in the country of issue; because the RMI is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention of 1961, formal legalization in RMI courts or before the Registrar requires consular certification by an RMI consular officer (RMI Embassy, Washington, D.C., or RMI Permanent Mission to the UN, New York) or processing via the RMI Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Majuro; licensed registered agents in practice accept apostilled or notarized copies for KYC purposes

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency, Certificate of Good Standing, or certified Certificate of Incorporation of any intermediate corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the jurisdiction of incorporation of the intermediate entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuing registry is located in a Convention state (accepted in agent and bank practice); consular legalization required where the RMI Registrar or a court is the intended recipient

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential or business address for each UBO and director (bank statement or utility bill issued within the preceding 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank or utility provider in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy accepted by the licensed agent; no apostille or consular path required in standard agent-level KYC practice

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional bank reference or legal reference letter (positive identification) for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank or law firm in a reputable AML jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Direct confirmation from the issuing institution to the licensed agent; no formal consular path

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO piercing chart, source of funds, and source of wealth declaration (statutory declaration signed before a notary)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Client-executed statutory declaration before a notary public in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization sufficient for agent-level KYC; consular legalization required only if the declaration is to be filed with the RMI Registrar, FIU, or a court

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory real-time screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against (i) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List; (ii) UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list; (iii) EU consolidated financial sanctions list; (iv) RMI FIU domestic advisories and designations; and (v) PEP databases covering politically exposed persons, family members, and close associates with a 5-year look-back. The jewelry and fine timepieces e-commerce scope (ISIC 4791) is profiled as Tier 2 Medium-Risk Enhanced: enhanced due diligence applies where a single invoice exceeds USD 10,000, where cross-border shipments involve FATF/APG high-risk jurisdictions, or where settlement uses non-banking channels. Adverse media screening in at least 6 languages and annual re-screening are mandatory; any positive hit must be escalated to the designated AML Compliance Officer with a written risk acceptance or rejection decision within 5 business days.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands (no public self-service online portal; all name search and reservation requests are transmitted through licensed registered agents or by direct written application to the Registrar)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English-language registry; corporate names are accepted in English/Roman (Latin) script only. No statutory transliteration doctrine is prescribed; foreign-language brand names (e.g., Mandarin) must be rendered in an approved Romanized form and are treated as arbitrary or fanciful tokens. Required corporate suffix: 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Company', 'Limited', or abbreviations 'Corp.', 'Inc.', 'Co.', 'Ltd.'. The Registrar applies a statutory distinguishability test: a name is refused if it is likely to be confused with an existing registered name, and the mere addition of non-distinctive words such as 'Group', 'Holdings', 'Online', 'Global', or 'International' will not cure confusion.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation is renewable for one further 30-day period upon written application and payment of the renewal fee. If the Registrar refuses a name on grounds of confusion, prohibited token, or illegality, the applicant through its licensed registered agent may file a written reconsideration request within 14 days of the refusal notice, identifying the distinguishing elements and enclosing any consent letters or ministerial approvals obtained. If reconsideration is denied, the applicant may petition the High Court for judicial review within 30 days of the denial, or promptly submit two alternative preferred names in a fresh application to preserve deal economics.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible under RMI law: every Business Corporation must maintain a registered office and a licensed registered agent within the Marshall Islands (typically the agent's premises in Majuro), and a purely virtual footprint with no staffed operational premises is lawful for a non-resident, tax-exempt BC. However, the target online jewelry and timepieces business cannot onboard to Stripe or PayPal using only the RMI registered-agent address. Stripe does not currently support entities incorporated in the Marshall Islands, and PayPal imposes supported-country, local-bank-account, and commercial verification requirements. Recommended structure: a non-resident RMI BC holding brand and treasury functions, supplemented by a merchant-account-bearing operating entity in a supported jurisdiction (e.g., US LLC or Hong Kong company) for Stripe and PayPal onboarding, with intercompany agreements for the e-commerce order flow.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (<5% annual probability) of any unannounced physical inspection of the principal remote or foreign operational premises because the RMI Registrar and the Financial Intelligence Unit exercise supervision primarily through the licensed registered agent in Majuro. The registered agent's office itself is subject to unannounced on-site examination pursuant to the Registered Agents Licensing Act 1991 and the AML/CFT Act 2012, and any inspection findings are attributed to client files at renewal.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and name reservation fee (one 30-day reservation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (Business Corporations Act name-reservation schedule); market practice may add a registered-agent handling charge

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation KYC/CDD and UBO piercing file preparation (identity verification, address verification, organizational chart, source of funds and source of wealth declarations)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (compliant corporate services provider)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a medium-risk e-commerce client file, typically USD 300-500

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, and EU sanctions screening (initial batch plus adverse-media screening)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance data provider (World-Check or equivalent) passed through the licensed registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per-name database charge, typically USD 2-5 per screened individual

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing fee (authorized capital up to USD 50,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (Business Corporations Act fee schedule tier based on authorized share capital)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office service, year 1
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a non-resident Business Corporation with an enhanced AML file, typically USD 800-1,500 per annum

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of origin documents (passport, power of attorney, statutory declarations)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in the jurisdiction of execution and RMI consular officer (Washington, D.C., or New York)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (notary fees plus RMI consular certification fee where applicable)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Good Standing or certified corporate extract of any intermediate corporate shareholder
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Companies registry issuing the certificate in the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff, varying by issuing jurisdiction

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act (BCA) of 1996, Title 52 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code, as amended; incorporation and organization pursuant to BCA Sections 48, 52, and 56; non-resident domestic corporation status under BCA Section 39.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Commercial and Corporate Affairs Section, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BCA-1), together with the Consent and Appointment of Licensed Registered Agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. A non-resident domestic Business Corporation may be formed without depositing any capital and may authorize shares with or without par value; no escrow or bank-account requirement within the Marshall Islands. An annual government franchise tax is payable to maintain good standing.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: that the Board subscribes to the issued shares set out in the Articles of Incorporation and adopts as the registered office the office of the licensed registered agent in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands. FURTHER RESOLVED: that the Bylaws are adopted in full and the following officers are appointed: President/Chief Executive Officer, Secretary, and Treasurer, with authority to execute documents in the ordinary course. FURTHER RESOLVED: that management is directed to open bank accounts, engage payment processing partners (Stripe, PayPal), and execute e-commerce platform agreements for the online sale of fashion jewelry and timepieces. FURTHER RESOLVED: that all pre-incorporation acts of the incorporators are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General (online name-search via licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit one to three proposed corporate names through the licensed registered agent; the Registrar conducts an availability and confusing-similarity search; reserve the approved name, with the reservation pending completion of the statutory filing.
required_dossiers: Authority letter from licensed registered agent
Passport copy of the appointing incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or flagged as confusingly similar, file an amended reservation with alternative names or submit a written consent from the holder of the conflicting name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator (natural person) and licensed Marshall Islands registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation including corporate name, purpose clause, authorized capital structure, registered-agent clause, and incorporator subscription. Execute before a notary public; the registered agent countersigns the consent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Registry corrections are returned to the registered agent for amendment, re-notarization, and re-submission without losing the filing date if cured within the statutory period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles and Payment of Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the executed Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar, pays the $200 government filing fee (plus licensed-agent service fees), and obtains the Registrar's stamped certificate of incorporation.
required_dossiers: Payment receipt for government filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the registered agent files an answer and pays any deficiency; a query does not cancel the application if a cure is submitted within 30 days, otherwise the file may be re-commenced.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of Registered Office and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent (Business Service Provider authorized by the Registrar of Corporations)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Post-incorporation, the registered agent confirms the registered office physical address in Majuro and updates its registry records; the agent maintains the statutory records at the registered office location for service of process and regulatory notices.
required_dossiers: Approved Articles of Incorporation and certificate of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the approved registered agent resigns, file a change of registered agent form with the Registrar within 30 days; failure to do so may lead to administrative dissolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting, First Board Resolution, and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator acting as sole director or the initial Board of Directors (BCA Section 56)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the organizational meeting or execute written consents in lieu of meeting; adopt Bylaws; populate the capitalization table and issue share certificates; elect directors and appoint officers; ratify pre-incorporation contracts and payment-service mandates.
required_dossiers: Meeting minutes or written consent in lieu of meeting
Share subscription ledger and share certificates
Appointment of officers and authority matrix
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If quorum or notice formalities are defective, cure by a subsequent unanimous written consent signed by all directors or incorporators.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for a non-resident e-commerce entity with no Marshall Islands physical premises. If a warehouse or manufacturing operation is later established, the competent authority would be the Business Licensing Division of the Ministry of Finance and the RMI Trade and Investment Commission.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no RMI business license, industrial permit, or retail storefront license is mandated for online sale of fashion jewelry and timepieces conducted wholly from outside the Republic of the Marshall Islands.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMIEPA) under the Environmental Protection Act 1984
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category 3 (no physical footprint, no electroplating or packaging production, and no waste generation within RMI territory)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero point-source discharge. No wastewater, VOC, or hazardous-waste thresholds are triggered for administrative-only operations. If bonded logistics or local stock-keeping is introduced, a waste-disposal registration would be required under EPA (Waste Management) Regulations, and wastewater permits would be triggered at discharge volumes above 1,000 gallons per day.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable — no physical office, storefront, or warehouse in RMI, and no locally resident employees; accordingly, no Marshall Islands fire safety certificate, structural load inspection, or occupational workplace clearance is triggered. If local premises are later acquired, clearance under the Fire Safety Act 1988 and a workplace inspection by the RMI Ministry of Health and Human Services would be required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Office (RTA), Ministry of Finance, Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands; principal office in Majuro; no electronic tax-filing portal (paper-based administration); corporate law registry administered separately by the Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations through licensed registered agents.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation (BC) is not required to obtain a Marshall Islands TIN unless it derives income from sources within the Marshall Islands or employs local personnel. Procedure: (1) incorporate via a licensed Marshall Islands registered agent; (2) obtain the RMI Business Corporation Number and Certificate of Good Standing; (3) if RMI-source income is anticipated, submit a written TIN application to the RTA (no statutory form fee for issuance; entity details and registered agent information required); (4) if no RMI-source income is derived, no TIN filing is made and no income-tax return is required; annual corporate renewal with the Registrar of Corporations remains mandatory.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists under Marshall Islands law. The Income Tax Act 1989 applies a strict territorial/source-based regime: a non-resident domestic BC is outside the RMI tax net provided it derives no RMI-source income, maintains no office or employees in the RMI, and conducts no sales activity within the RMI. Exemption is automatic, not elective; an entity may evidence its status by filing a voluntary non-resident declaration or nil-return with the RTA and by maintaining proper registered-agent records; no OECD hybrid rules apply.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None - the Republic of the Marshall Islands imposes no VAT, GST, sales and use tax, excise, or any other indirect tax regime at the national or sub-national level.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - no indirect tax regime exists and therefore no turnover-based registration threshold, VAT ID, or indirect tax compliance obligation arises for the BC.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None - the RMI operates no real-time fiscal clearance system, no e-invoicing API mandate, no digital tax stamping requirement, and no continuous transaction control regime for jewelry, watches, fashion, or any other e-commerce trade.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable - because the Marshall Islands levies no VAT, GST, or sales tax, there is no zero-rating mechanism to claim and no export VAT refund regime. Exports of jewelry, watches, and fashion e-commerce goods from the RMI are subject to no RMI indirect tax charge; customs may apply documentary survey only for statistical and prohibited-goods control purposes.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (RMI Customs export entry where goods physically clear Majuro or other RMI ports)
Commercial Invoice (seller, buyer, HS Code at 6-digit level, Incoterms, unit value, total value and currency)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (ocean/air transport evidence for the outbound movement)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT/MT103 credit advice evidencing export proceeds receipt
Certificate of Origin (only where required by the destination market's preferential tariff scheme)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No indirect-tax clawback or zero-rating fraud penalty exists in the RMI because no VAT regime is in force. Scrutiny focuses on (i) income tax: if the RTA asserts RMI-source income (e.g., sales consummated within the RMI or domestic payroll), late-filing and non-filing penalties accrue monthly (up to 25% of tax due), negligence and fraud penalties may reach 100% of the assessed tax, interest applies, and criminal prosecution for tax evasion is available; (ii) customs: false export declarations attract fines, forfeiture of goods, and suspension of the exporter's customs privileges; (iii) AML/CFT: under the RMI Financial Transactions Reporting Act, failure to document export proceeds or to file suspicious transaction reports can expose the BC to civil penalties and license/registered-agent remedial action; adequate commercial, shipping, and banking records must be retained for at least five years to substantiate the offshore-source character of all revenue.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) maintains no central bank and no foreign exchange control authority. Monetary and banking supervision is vested in the Banking Commissioner under the RMI Banking Commission (Ministry of Finance), operating pursuant to the Banking Act 1998 (as amended) and the Financial Institutions Act. The United States Federal Reserve acts as the de facto monetary anchor because the US Dollar (USD) is the sole legal tender under the Compact of Free Association.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full de jure and de facto convertibility. USD is legal tender; there are zero exchange controls, no capital account restrictions, no prior-approval requirements for capital inflows or profit remittances, and no repatriation taxes or withholding constraints for non-resident Business Corporations. The only practical hurdle is downstream compliance with US OFAC sanctions and correspondent-bank due diligence, as all USD clearing ultimately settles through Fedwire/CHIPS at US correspondent institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. RMI law imposes no statutory surrender timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation deadline for export proceeds, including online merchandising receipts from jewelry, watches, and fashion goods. Exporters may retain proceeds in USD or any freely convertible currency in any domestic or foreign bank, without reporting obligations to the RMI authorities.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Corporate Checking Account; optional Capital Escrow Account for subscribed paid-up capital

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam – Marshall Islands Branch
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Account with US correspondent clearing via Bank of Guam (Guam, USA)
Development credit facility; not suitable for general treasury or merchant settlement

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-High viability with a foreign-license dependency. RMI does not operate a stand-alone EMI or e-money licensing regime; unlicensed money transmission within RMI is unlawful under the Financial Institutions Act. A foreign-licensed Electronic Money Institution (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, or similar) can lawfully serve an RMI Business Corporation as an offshore payment processor provided the EMI holds an active license in a FATF-compliant jurisdiction (FCA-UK, EU-EMI, MAS-Singapore) and the RMI entity is onboarded as a merchant counterparty rather than as a local payment institution. Practical limitation: EMIs generally cannot open USD corporate accounts in RMI domestic banks; they operate as sub-accounts routed via partner banks, which may trigger enhanced due diligence on high-value jewelry/watch transactions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is permitted under a hybrid documentary KYC regime. RMI banks accept notarized and apostilled corporate documents, certified true passport copies of all directors and beneficial owners (natural persons holding ≥10%), and a video-call interview with the bank's Compliance Officer. Physical branch appearance is not statutorily mandated for non-resident entities; however, Bank of Guam – Marshall Islands Branch reserves the right to require an in-person or video interview for merchant clients classified as Medium_Risk_Enhanced. Beneficial ownership details must be filed with the RMI Banking Commission. A board resolution designating authorized signatories and treasury counterparties is universally required.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owners domiciled outside FATF/Egmont-compliant jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled Certificate of Incorporation and Articles of Incorporation; current Certificate of Good Standing from the RMI Registrar; certified register of directors and shareholders identifying all natural-person beneficial owners; government-issued passport copies; notarized source-of-wealth statement with corresponding bank confirmation for initial capital injection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value fashion jewelry and fine timepiece transactions invoking enhanced due diligence under RMI AML/CFT guidelines (Medium_Risk_Enhanced tier)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Itemized commercial invoices matching SKU, serial number (for watches), and gemstone certification where applicable; platform settlement statements from Stripe and PayPal; shipping carrier (DHL, FedEx, UPS) proof-of-delivery records; customs declarations; inventory purchase contracts from wholesale suppliers; audited or management accounts demonstrating consistent gross margin.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: US correspondent bank de-risking pressure on RMI entities, threatening termination of nostro clearing relationships
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank reference letter from a prior regulated banking relationship; three to six months of pre-onboarding merchant transaction history from Stripe/PayPal; board resolution committing to transaction-level documentation and restricted-commodity compliance; written undertaking to route only permissible-commodity payments with no cash equivalents, no crypto-adjacent flows, and no dealings with sanctioned jurisdictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid inbound wire concentration from multiple foreign jurisdictions triggering anti-wire-stripping and sanctions filters
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Underlying purchase orders and trade agreements linking each remitter to specific merchandise; stable counterparty list with names and jurisdictions; OFAC-compliant customer due diligence files for all recurring payment counterparties; sworn affidavit of no sanctioned-party involvement; transaction narrative codes aligned with ISO 20022 purpose codes (GENT or INTC).

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital injection executes via SWIFT MT103 wire from a FATF-compliant originator bank to the RMI corporate USD operational account, settling over US correspondent rails (Fedwire/CHIPS). Payment narrative must state exactly: 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION – [ENTITY NAME] – MARSHALL ISLANDS BUSINESS CORPORATION – REGISTRATION NUMBER [XXXX]' and include ISO 20022 purpose code 'CAPT' (Capital Transfer). Verification bundle: duly adopted directors' resolution authorizing share issuance; RMI Registrar Certificate of Good Standing; source-of-funds confirmation from the remitting bank. For intercompany loans, use purpose code 'INTC' (Intercompany Payment) with a written loan agreement and arm's-length interest terms to prevent recharacterization as equity.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Routine supplier replenishment payments for jewelry, watches, and fashion inventory execute via SWIFT MT103 (telegraphic transfer) for transactions under USD 250,000. High-value procurement contracts use irrevocable documentary letters of credit under UCP 600, advised by the RMI entity's bank and confirmed by a G7-based confirming bank, payable at sight. USD clearing settles via CHIPS/Fedwire; EUR via TARGET2; GBP via CHAPS; JPY via FXYCS. All MT103 narratives must include the RMI entity's bank reference, supplier invoice number, and merchandise description ('fine watches', 'fashion jewelry') to avoid wire-stripping failures and to substantiate the Medium_Risk_Enhanced compliance file.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forwards (USD/EUR, USD/GBP, USD/JPY, USD/AUD) executed with licensed OECD-based banking counterparties, no RMI-specific regulatory restriction

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) overlay for end-market currencies with restricted onshore liquidity (e.g., USD/INR, USD/BRL) where customer payment rails (Stripe, PayPal) create multi-currency receivables exposure
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR, USD/GBP) for medium-term treasury liquidity alignment on large watch-boutique purchase contracts
Vanilla European FX options (long-only, premium-paid) to cap downside on concentrated foreign-currency settlement months at peak holiday season

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Registry Report (Annual Return containing current directors, officers, registered agent, registered office, authorized and issued capital, and shareholder summary)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on or before the anniversary date of incorporation each year; no extension is granted by the Registrar; signed documentation must be delivered to the registered agent no later than 7 business days before the anniversary for timely filing.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 50 per month or part of a month; failure to file for two consecutive annual reporting periods authorizes the Registrar to administratively strike the corporation off the register and dissolve it.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a non-resident Business Corporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act. A mandatory independent audit arises only if the corporation is listed or publicly traded on a recognized stock exchange or if an appointed regulator or lender imposes an audit condition; otherwise the directors are required only to keep and maintain true and accurate books and accounts.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory accounting framework exists for non-resident Marshall Islands Business Corporations. Financial statements may be prepared under IFRS, IFRS for SMEs, or US GAAP; financial statements are not filed with the Registrar or tax authorities for non-resident corporations deriving no Marshall Islands-source income.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The corporation must maintain a private Register of Beneficial Owners at its registered office and update it on every share issuance, transfer, or change in beneficial ownership. Registered agents will require an annual certificate from the board or a director confirming current members, directors, officers, and beneficial owners; share transfer notifications must be provided within 14 days of the transfer, and the register must be updated before the transfer is recorded in the Register of Members. The UBO register is not filed with any public authority but is accessible to the Registrar upon lawful request.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 650 – USD 1,200 per annum for registered office, registered agent service, and routine corporate secretarial administration; volume discounts are typically available for multi-entity groups.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; if voluntarily prepared for financing, buyer due diligence, or board oversight purposes, a certified audit of a small e-commerce holding entity is approximately USD 3,000 – USD 8,000.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 3% on the first USD 5,000,000 of Marshall Islands-source taxable income plus 5% on the excess (Income Tax Act 1989, Title 30 MIRC). A Non-Resident Domestic Business Corporation deriving exclusively foreign-source income from the online merchandising of fashion jewelry and fine timepieces has an effective corporate income tax rate of 0%.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation applies: non-resident domestic corporations are taxable only on income sourced within the Marshall Islands. The present structure (foreign e-commerce sales routed through Stripe and PayPal, no MH office, no MH customers, no local management) produces zero MH-source income. Statutory non-impositions: no VAT/GST, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax on foreign-based staff, no branch profits tax, and no accumulated earnings tax. No codified income-tax loss carryforward regime applies to this entity; the 5-year value is a notional template default only.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Report and Franchise Tax Return - filed with the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Commerce, via a licensed Marshall Islands registered agent; no public taxpayer e-filing portal exists
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before 1 October of each calendar year (Business Corporations Act); a 10% late-payment penalty applies to the unpaid annual franchise tax

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered legal name, registration number, and date of incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact name appearing on the Certificate of Incorporation; consistency is verified against the Registrar's registry

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address and licensed resident agent in the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A physical MH registered office is mandatory; the agent accepts legal process on behalf of the BC

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number and par value of authorized shares; these figures determine the USD 250 to USD 1,000 annual franchise tax bracket
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The standard default is USD 500 for authorizations up to 1,000,000 shares; a false declaration to reduce the franchise tax constitutes an infraction

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names and residential addresses of all directors and officers currently in office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are expressly permitted; provide beneficial-ownership documentation identical to Stripe and PayPal filings for AML consistency

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the BC is non-resident, is not controlled by MH residents, and transacts no business within the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any direct sale into the Marshall Islands must be disclosed; undeclared MH-source revenue would attract the 3%/5% corporate income tax

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: 10% late-payment penalty on the franchise tax plus continuing interest; after approximately 90 days of non-payment the Registrar may annul the articles of incorporation, causing loss of the limited liability shield for contracts entered after annulment; reinstatement incurs additional government fees

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Marshall Islands Corporate Income Tax Return - no form exists and no return is accepted for non-resident domestic corporations with no MH-source income
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No statutory filing deadline applies to this entity class

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The Income Tax Act 1989 imposes no return obligation where taxable income is nil
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain a permanent file evidencing (i) no MH-source revenue, (ii) foreign e-commerce gross receipts, and (iii) the filed MH annual report receipt; this file substantiates the 0% effective rate during bank, Stripe, or PayPal AML review

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No statutory penalty; however, absence of supporting documentation may trigger adverse inferences in foreign tax, AML, and beneficial ownership examinations

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - the Marshall Islands imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by a Business Corporation to shareholders of any residency; distributions are paid gross
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable - the Marshall Islands has no comprehensive double tax agreement network and no dividend withholding tax to reclaim. The Compacts of Free Association with the United States are not income tax treaties and confer no treaty-rate protocol. No Tax Residence Certificate application or relief procedure exists; the BC may repatriate profits by board-declared dividend or director resolution without administrative approval, subject only to the solvency rules of the Business Corporations Act
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on interest and intellectual property royalties paid by a Marshall Islands BC to non-residents; no reduced DTA rates are available or necessary because the domestic statutory rate and the no-treaty default both equal 0%

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold applies - the Marshall Islands has not enacted transfer-pricing documentation rules and imposes no Local File or Master File obligation in USD or any other currency. As risk-based best practice for this jewelry and watches e-commerce structure, maintain intercompany pricing and cost allocation records once annual related-party revenue exceeds USD 1,000,000 or where Stripe or PayPal underwriting requires proof of commercial substance
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Marshall Islands law does not enact EU-style Economic Substance Regulations; a Non-Resident BC has no statutory local substance requirement. However, the Medium_Risk_Enhanced AML tier applied by Stripe, PayPal, and correspondent banks effectively tests substance: maintain board minutes, a share register, the corporate records book, and inventory or procurement contracts demonstrating genuine control over the jewelry and timepiece trade. Absent these records, merchant accounts are exposed to freezing and termination for shell-entity indicators
